# workshop.hdr

- Source: "Wide Street 02" by Sergej Majboroda, Poly Haven, https://polyhaven.com/a/wide_street_02
- Licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain), https://polyhaven.com/license
- Downloaded 2026-10-10 as the 1k HDR (1,519,162 bytes) and shrunk to 512 × 256 with `tools/blender/make_env.py` to fit the 400 KB budget in ADR 0014.
- Chosen as a bright, clear midday street, the closest available match to an open roadside workshop in Lagos. Replace it with a photographed environment if the owner takes one.
